name: setlister
description: Local Sendungsverwaltung for podcast playlists (artists, albums, tracks, episodes) with HTML/social-media output generation.

scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run dev --workspace apps/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/client && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace packages/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
